subject: Write comprehensive test suite and verify correctness
description:
Create comprehensive tests in /Users/huawang/pyproject/agentholdem/tests/:

1. **tests/__init__.py** - empty
2. **tests/test_card.py** - Test card creation, comparison, string representation
3. **tests/test_deck.py** - Test deck creation (52 cards), shuffle, deal, no duplicates
4. **tests/test_hand_eval.py** - CRITICAL: Thorough hand evaluation tests:
   - Test each hand type (royal flush through high card)
   - Test hand comparison (flush beats straight, etc.)
   - Test kicker comparisons (same pair, better kicker wins)
   - Test wheel straight (A-2-3-4-5)
   - Test ace-high straight (10-J-Q-K-A)
   - Test full house comparisons
   - Test best-5-from-7 selection
   - Test tie/split pot scenarios
5. **tests/test_game.py** - Game engine tests:
   - Test blind posting
   - Test betting round progression
   - Test limit bet amounts (small bet preflop/flop, big bet turn/river)
   - Test raise cap (max 4 bets per round)
   - Test fold action
   - Test all-in scenarios
   - Test pot distribution
   - Test heads-up blind rules
6. **tests/test_ai.py** - AI tests:
   - Test that AI returns valid actions
   - Test different difficulty levels produce different behavior patterns
   - Test AI respects betting rules (doesn't raise past cap, etc.)

Run all tests with pytest and ensure they pass. Fix any bugs found.

This depends on all previous tasks being complete.
